chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Santos against Flamengo, July 2011. Neymar gets it by the touchline. Two defenders close in. He cuts inside and races away! Pass to Borges, straight back... one defender left... goal!

chapters.label: Watch the trick
chapters.text: Watch the trick, slowly. The defender steps in front. Neymar pokes the ball past one side, runs round the other side, and picks it up!

chapters.label: Past the keeper
chapters.text: Even as he falls, he slides it past the keeper. It won the Puskás Award!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: practise one trick again and again, until it's automatic. Then use it when a defender gets close!
